proposals.statement: For every finite list rs of natural numbers with every entry in {2,3,4}, including the empty list and repetitions, put N=rs.sum and P(X)=(1+2X)*product_{r in rs}((1+X)^r+X)+X*(1+X)^(N+1) in Polynomial Rat. For every natural k, if the zero-extended coefficient P[k+1] is strictly less than P[k], then 2N<=5k.
proposals.scope: Exact coefficient-only theorem for any strict descent, including the terminal difference; rational polynomial coefficients and natural-number conclusion. The weight N+1 is not the actual degree of P. No graph interpretation, m>=1, first-descent minimality, eligibility guards, ratio bound, selected MASS, payment, or primary theorem.

relationship_to_existing.description: The exact coefficient theorem implies only the composite key's first-descent rank clause on its m>=1 polynomial profiles: 2N<=5x is equivalent over integers to 5x>2N-1. It supplies none of that key's eligible-rank or ratio assertions. Do not mark the entire composite key formally verified from this lemma.
